specialty.name: Metamagic Adept
specialty.description: Halon can use Metamagic one additional time per combat.

specialty.name: Divine Mandate
specialty.description: Castle heroes begin with Divine Mandate. Once per combat, cast a Light Spell after issuing an Order, or issue an Order after casting a Light Spell.

specialty.name: Shroud of Malassa
specialty.description: Dungeon heroes begin with the Shroud of Malassa. Friendly stacks may move through occupied creature hexes, and flanking melee attacks deal increased damage.

specialty.name: Bulwark of the Mire
specialty.tooltip: Faction skill: Bulwark of the Mire
specialty.description: Fortress heroes begin with Bulwark of the Mire. A defending friendly stack gains additional physical protection and a pre-emptive strike against its first melee attacker.

specialty.name: Necromancy
specialty.description: Necropolis heroes begin with Necromancy. After victory, eligible living enemy casualties can be raised as Skeletons.

specialty.name: Sylvan Luck
specialty.description: Rampart heroes begin with Sylvan Luck. It improves Luck and increases the payoff of a Lucky Strike.

specialty.name: Bloodrage
specialty.description: Stronghold heroes begin with Bloodrage. Each non-summoned stack destroyed increases the damage dealt by surviving friendly stacks.
